ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) across ~90-95% of the surface area with sparse, high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark base with high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and scattered circular/linear white points across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 110 degrees; depth occupies roughly 12% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities across the entire trailing edge; notable semi-circular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe (viewer's left).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a consistent convex curve from the distal tips toward the median notch; distal tips are sharp and angled upward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of circular white pixel rings (0.5-2.0% of lobe width) across the central surface of both lobes, suggesting previous barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, long, curvilinear white scar on the right lobe (viewer's right) extending from the mid-section toward the trailing edge; multiple shorter, unaligned linear streaks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Live barnacle colonization visible as high-contrast, textured white calcifications localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; extensive linear rake marks (parallel scarring) on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique density of white calcified matter specifically concentrated at the furthest distal points of the fluke lobes.
